one_line_judgement: 今天值得试：据摘要（arXiv 2610.06829）：CLIFT（ConformaL self-verIFication for web agent …
one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06829）：CLIFT（ConformaL self-verIFication for web agent Training and Test-Time Scaling）把 open-source web agent 强化学习的'binary task success 太稀疏、frontier-LM judge 太贵且部署时不可用'拉到'conformal self-verification 自校准 verifier'——训练时让 agent 答 natural-language verification question，部署时用 conformal 给出校准过的置信度。是 ai-agent × llm-evaluation × rag-knowledge 的'conformal self-verification for web agent'即时资产——'self-verification replaces frontier judge'范式可迁移到任何'sparse reward + expensive judge'子方向（code agent / tool-use agent / multi-step planning），与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation × rag-knowledge 主线在'calibrated self-supervision for agent RL'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 conformal 形式化（miscoverage guarantee / non-conformity score 设计）、跨 web agent baseline（WebArena / Mind2Web）、test-time scaling 协议、与 frontier-judge baseline 对照。今日动作：即时路线资产，写'clift conformal self-verification' checklist 草稿。
